newsitem.title: EGYPT: Suspected militants kill two in southern Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Suspected militants kill two in southern Egypt.

text.p: Suspected Moslem militants shot dead a farmer and his son in southern Egypt on Thursday, security sources said.
They said Zakher Youssef Zakher, 41, and his son Saeed, 22, were killed as they worked in their fields in Bani Ebied village, near the town of Abu Qorqas, south of Cairo.

Police in Abu Qorqas believe the gunmen were members of the militant al-Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), which is waging a low-level guerrilla war in southern Egypt as part of its campaign to overthrow the government and install a strict Islamic state.
The militants have targeted mainly policemen in the south, but they occasionally kill civilians they suspect had helped security forces.
More than 1,000 people have been killed in political violence in Egypt since militants launched their drive in 1992.
